_about: Feat loop batch 5, lane b5-other (2026-11-26): the meditation line finished, luck that
takes 10 or is lent, Wind Stance, the social openings and the teamwork leftovers. Text
read in content/feats/feats.json (aonprd.com FeatDisplay pages) 2026-11-26; the feats
whose class, race or system no player can take yet are in docs/feats-waiting-on-classes.md.
wind-stance: CRB: 'If you move more than 5 feet this turn, you gain 20% concealment for 1 round against ranged attacks' (rules/feat_moves.py `_wind_stance`).

combat-meditation: F&P: 'expend the +1 insight bonus granted from the Meditation Master feat to instead roll twice when attempting an ability check, attack roll, saving throw, or skill check, taking the better of the two results. You must decide to use this ability before the initial roll is made.' The meditation itself is the use in content/class-abilities/feats-b4-maneuver.json.

slow-time: F&P: 'Once per day, when you meditate as a full-round action using the Combat Meditation feat, you gain the effects of haste for 1 round per 2 character levels' — the addon on Combat Meditation's use (feats-b4-maneuver.json).

perfect-center: F&P: 'You can take 10 on any skill check or concentration check, even if it is not normally allowed due to strenuous circumstances.' The player's popup offers it; anybody else takes 10 when 10 makes it (Engine._take_ten).
betrayer: UC: a Diplomacy check that moves a creature's attitude opens it to the bearer's blow for the round (Engine._betrayer_opening).
ferocious-loyalty: The +2 after an ally with the feat falls within 30 feet: feat_events._ferocious_loyalty.

modifiers.note: F&P: 'For 1 round per character level after you perform combat meditation, whenever you attempt a concentration check to avoid losing a spell or a Fortitude save to resist a distraction effect ... you gain a +4 bonus'

not_yet: 'retry a single failed Diplomacy check against a creature' at -4 on the Bluff: a creature's attitude is moved once a day (Scene.swayed), the owner's 2026-11-22 ruling, so a retried check has nowhere to land
'If the creature knows you are dangerous, it adds a +4 bonus to its Sense Motive check': nothing records what a creature knows of the prisoner

the blow 'as an immediate action' before anybody else acts: an attack out of a fight opens one through the battle gate and initiative is rolled first, so the blow comes on the bearer's turn (the -2 initiative is laid in time for that roll)

modifiers.note: Blood of the Moon: '+1 morale bonus on attack rolls against any foe that currently threatens an ally who also has this feat'

not_yet: an ally rendered helpless by anything but a blow (a spell's paralysis, a sleep): only the attack that fells is seen to do it
every clause asks 'when wearing a helmet': no helmet is an item a sheet can wear (lane b5-core is building one)
every clause asks 'when wearing a helmet': no helmet is an item a sheet can wear (lane b5-core is building one)

modifiers.note: ARG: '+2 bonus on Craft (alchemy) and Profession (brewer) checks' — the alchemist's bench check is the game's Craft (alchemy)

not_yet: Profession (brewer)'s +2: Profession is one skill id (the trades fold, 2026-10-07), and a Profession check does not say which trade it is made in
'+1 to the DC of any ingested poison you create': no bench makes an ingested poison

moving at full speed through enchanted thorns, briars and overgrowth, entangling or not: woodland stride itself is not built (the druid's and ranger's grant is a name on the class table), and no magical vegetation is terrain the move prices

intercepting a successful attack on the ally your aid another guards, taking its full damage and riders as an immediate action: the attack loop resolves a blow on the one defender it was aimed at, and nothing hands a landed blow to another body
both rolling the save against one compulsion or emotion effect and either using either result: a cast's saves are rolled target by target, and no save sees an ally's roll of the same effect
the Bluff to trade a worthless object for a better one, the attitude worsening on a failure by 5, and the opposed Appraise after: no door swaps held items between the player and a creature by a check
